scripts.setup: npm run setup:api && npm run setup:web
scripts.setup:api: cd API && python3.12 -m venv venv && venv/bin/pip install -U pip && venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]'
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.lint: cd API && venv/bin/ruff check app tests
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm --prefix Web exec tsc -- -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit
